title: Webhook rejection
action: Investigate immediately - either an attack or a config error breaking payments

title: Refund refused by policy
action: A refund was requested and declined. Correct behaviour - but SHOULD NOT HAPPEN in normal operation, and nothing else moves on this path, so a spike means a status-mapping regression or a customer-facing dispute

title: Ledger drift
action: Money is wrong. Freeze changes, investigate

title: Relay 5xx
action: The relay is up but the backend is not

title: Relay down
action: Total outage - single point of failure

title: Balance negative
action: Should be impossible (CHECK constraint). A bug

title: DB disk >80%
condition: any age-based table holding a row past its retention window

title: Stranded reservation hold
condition: `reserve_*` negative ledger row with no positive row under the same ref
threshold: 0 (must equal 0); incident at two consecutive sweeps
action: Investigate the release path and credit the account if the hold is lost
